title: Bulk Email Fair List Source Permission Consistency

items.action: authorize the Bulk Email send action and wizard business flow
discover and select fairs for the fair-list recipient source

migration.reason: Existing fair email execute and fair read permissions are reused.

backend.reason: Existing backend fair read and Bulk Email send authorization remain unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; the existing fair lookup client already fails closed without fair_crm.fairs.read.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: Wizard entry prerequisites are owned by the separate Bulk Email mail-settings/entry contracts; this contract only gates the optional fair-list source.

notes: Bulk Email wizard entry always requires fair_crm.fair_emails.execute together with the mandatory fair_crm.mail_templates.read and fair_crm.email_accounts.read lookup prerequisites. Once those entry prerequisites are satisfied, the manual recipient source requires no additional fair permission. The optional fair-list recipient source is a separate fair-discovery capability: it is hidden and its change handler fails closed when fair_crm.fairs.read is absent, preventing the shared FairEntitySelect from attempting a lookup that the fair client would reject. Preview remains independently governed by fair_crm.fair_emails.read.
